title: Moon Kaomoji (´-ω-`)☾: Copy & Paste Moon, Sun & Space Faces
meta_description: Copy and paste moon kaomoji: sleepy goodnight faces (´-ω-`)☾, moon frames ☽(◕‿◕)☾, sunny faces ☼(◕‿◕)☼, UFOs (⊙ω⊙)🛸 and rockets for space captions.
hero_tagline: Goodnight faces with a crescent moon, sunny good-morning faces and astronauts, rockets and UFOs, all in text. Tap any line to copy it.
intro: Moon kaomoji use two crescent characters from the Miscellaneous Symbols block: ☽ (U+263D) opens to the right and ☾ (U+263E) to the left, so a pair can frame a face like ☽(◕‿◕)☾. The sun is ☀ or the outlined ☼, and ☄ (U+2604) is a comet with a tail. Moon faces are mostly a way to say goodnight, sun faces a way to say good morning, and space faces suit launch news, astronomy posts and late-night chats. Faces where the star itself is the focus, like (★ω★), live on the star kaomoji page linked below, and the full set of moon phases and planet symbols is on the moon and celestial symbols page.

sections.label: Sun
sections.intro: For good mornings, beach days and heat waves. ☼ is the outlined sun, ☀ the filled one.

sections.label: Space
sections.intro: Rockets, planets, comets and visitors from elsewhere. 🛸 and 🪐 are newer emoji, so very old devices may show a box.

faq.q: What is the difference between ☽ and ☾?
faq.a: Both are crescent moons in the Miscellaneous Symbols block. ☽ (U+263D, first quarter) has its open side on the right and ☾ (U+263E, last quarter) on the left. Put ☽ before a face and ☾ after it to frame it.

faq.q: What does (´-ω-`)☾ mean in a message?
faq.a: It is a goodnight. The -ω- is a face with closed eyes and the crescent sets the time of day, so people send it as the last message before sleeping.

faq.q: Is there a planet or UFO character that is not an emoji?
faq.a: Not a ringed planet or a flying saucer. Unicode has astronomical symbols such as ♄ for Saturn and ☄ for a comet, but the saucer and the ringed planet exist only as the 🛸 and 🪐 emoji.
